description: Not a lever: the per-request output ceiling of the four-card Swift stack, 16,384 -> 32,768 tokens. QWEN_FAST_OUTPUT_BUDGET may be a multiple of 256 up to 32,768 (serving_fast_policy); the ceiling reaches Swift alone, as the catalog entry's request.output_budget (qwen_c2_checkpoints.json, serving_c2_contract.checkpoint_limits and configure_checkpoint), refused by name on a profile that is not C2-any beside the extent readers or whose prompt cap it would lower. The ship-4 profile and its waiver are byte-identical and no profile of the file asks for more than 16,384; the omitted-max_tokens default stays 16,384 and the prompt cap 253,920. On the serving shape the ceiling allocates no device memory (docs/tp4-np9-answer32k.md); it costs KV admission: a request reserves prompt + max_tokens blocks of the 16,499.
notes: Shared files this package edits: serving_fast_policy.py (the bound), serving_c2_contract.py (output_budget_problems, checkpoint_budget_problems, checkpoint_limits, configure_checkpoint, boot), qwen_c2_checkpoint.py and qwen_c2_checkpoints.json (the request.output_budget key and the Swift entry), c2_serving_smoke.py (the opt-in long_answer_* tests), c2_smoke_check.py (long_answer_problems), test_qwen_c2_checkpoint.py. Every change is off for the base and for every profile of qwen_c2_profiles.json.
